one_liner: QuickBooks Online has a broad accounting API and an Intuit-published local MCP server, but the path to credentials for a new developer is unclear.

auth.notes: Requires a developer app and OAuth flow; per-user API keys are not offered.

access.notes: The instructions describe connecting a developer app to a sandbox or production company, but do not establish whether a new developer can obtain credentials without payment or approval.

api.notes: Public readability of the API reference is unverified; it could not be read through the available reader. The REST-specific SDK quote is a component description rather than a complete sentence.

mcp.notes: Intuit publishes a local MCP server.

verdict.rationale: Intuit describes broad API coverage and requires app registration and OAuth. The evidence does not establish whether a new developer can obtain credentials without payment or approval.

evidence.quote: This server uses OAuth 2.0 to authenticate to a QuickBooks Online company.
If you only want to read your own company's data, you still need to set up an app — Intuit does not offer per-user API keys.
You'll set up an app on the Intuit Developer Portal and connect it to either a sandbox (for development) or your production QBO company.
You must register an app on the Intuit Developer Portal and complete a one-time, browser-based OAuth handshake.
The QuickBooks Online Java SDK provides a set of Java class libraries that make it easier to call QuickBooks Online APIs, and access to QuickBooks Online data.
ipp-v3-java-devkit - core component, contains REST API support.
It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, giving you comprehensive access to QuickBooks Online functionality.
This MCP server provides complete QuickBooks Online API integration for Claude Code and other MCP-compatible clients.
Note: this is a local MCP server.
Quickbooks is a cloud-based accounting software that helps you manage your finances, track your income and expenses, and get insights into your business
